name: GeoMap Indonesia Candidate Geological & Structural Features
description: Candidate geological features, active fault traces, subduction trenches, and structural complex boundaries staged for review and verification.

properties.name: Sesar Lembang (Active Fault Trace)
properties.description: Active sinistral strike-slip fault stretching ~29 km north of the Bandung Basin, representing active intraplate tectonic deformation.
properties.evidence_description: Morphotectonic fault scarps, offset stream channels, and shallow seismic activity along the Lembang escarpment.
properties.evidence_significance: Demonstrates active intraplate crustal deformation and seismic hazard risk in West Java.
properties.why_it_matters: Sesar Lembang provides critical scientific evidence of active faulting near major population centers, driving earthquake microzonation and disaster risk reduction.
properties.source: Badan Geologi ESDM (Media Center & Technical Report)
properties.geometry_note: LineString representation of fault trace (interface visual convention, not official cartographic trace)

properties.name: Sesar Cimandiri (Fault Zone)
properties.description: Active strike-slip fault zone extending SW-NE from Pelabuhanratu Bay through Sukabumi and Cianjur.
properties.evidence_description: Linear river valley morphology, triangular facets, and historical earthquake ruptures.
properties.evidence_significance: Key structural boundary separating northern volcanic belt from southern accretionary complex.
properties.why_it_matters: Cimandiri faulting accounts for major destructive earthquakes in West Java, highlighting regional intraplate tectonic stress.
properties.geometry_note: LineString representation of fault zone (interface visual convention)

properties.name: Sesar Baribis (Thrust Belt Zone)
properties.description: Major back-arc thrust fault belt extending east-west across northern West Java.
properties.evidence_description: Compressional thrusting structures, geodetic strain rate anomalies, and focal mechanisms.
properties.evidence_significance: Represents back-arc compression driven by Indo-Australian subduction dynamics.
properties.why_it_matters: Understanding Baribis thrusting is critical for evaluating seismic risk across the densely populated northern Java corridor.
properties.geometry_note: LineString representation of thrust zone (interface visual convention)

properties.name: Sesar Opak (Bantul Fault Zone)
properties.description: Active strike-slip fault traversing the Opak River valley in Bantul, Yogyakarta.
properties.evidence_description: Ground rupture zones, accelerograph microzonation data, and 2006 earthquake hypocenters.
properties.evidence_significance: Illustrates how shallow intraplate faulting in sediment basins amplifies ground motion.
properties.why_it_matters: Directly linked to the 2006 Yogyakarta earthquake, serving as a benchmark site for sediment basin microzonation.
properties.geometry_note: LineString representation of fault trace (interface visual convention)

properties.name: Sesar Besar Sumatra (Semangko Segment)
properties.description: Southern segment of the ~1,900 km Great Sumatran dextral strike-slip fault system.
properties.evidence_description: Right-lateral stream offsets, linear pull-apart graben basins, and thermal springs.
properties.evidence_significance: Accommodates oblique subduction strain partitioning along the Sumatra margin.
properties.why_it_matters: Classic world example of strain partitioning along an oblique subduction zone.
properties.source: Badan Geologi ESDM & Sieh and Natawidjaja (2000)
properties.geometry_note: LineString representation of fault segment (interface visual convention)

properties.name: Sesar Sorong (Fault System)
properties.description: Major left-lateral transform fault zone in Eastern Indonesia, accommodating Pacific-Australian plate motion.
properties.evidence_description: Transpressional ridges, pull-apart basins, and displaced continental fragments.
properties.evidence_significance: Key strike-slip structure transporting continental fragments from Australia/PNG westward into the Banda arc region.
properties.why_it_matters: Demonstrates rapid strike-slip terrane transport shaping Eastern Indonesia's complex tectonic mosaic.
properties.geometry_note: LineString representation of fault system (interface visual convention)

properties.name: Palung Subduksi Sunda-Jawa (Sunda-Java Trench)
properties.description: ~3,000 km oceanic trench where oceanic Indo-Australian Plate subducts beneath Sundaland continental plate.
properties.rock_type: Oceanic basalt, pelagic sediments, accretionary wedge
properties.evidence_description: Deep bathymetric depression (>7,000 m), Wadati-Benioff seismic zone, and forearc basin deformation.
properties.evidence_significance: Primary convergent megathrust driving regional volcanism, trench accretion, and megathrust earthquakes.
properties.why_it_matters: The Sunda-Java Trench is Earth's premier convergent margin driving the Sunda Volcanic Arc and megathrust tsunamigenic hazards.
properties.source: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program & Nature Comms
properties.geometry_note: LineString representation of subduction trench axis (interface visual convention)

properties.name: Kompleks Mélange Ciletuh (Subduction Complex)
properties.description: Pre-Tertiary subduction mélange complex exposed at Ciletuh, West Java, featuring chaotic blocks of ophiolite, metamorphic schists, and deep-marine sediments.
properties.evidence_description: Exposed tectonic mélange blocks comprising oceanic crustal rocks (serpentinized peridotites) embedded in a sheared argillaceous matrix.
properties.evidence_significance: Provides direct petrological evidence of ancient Cretaceous subduction accretion along the southern margin of Sundaland.
properties.why_it_matters: Ciletuh exposes Java's oldest basement rocks, allowing geoscientists to reconstruct Cretaceous plate subduction history.
properties.source: UNESCO Ciletuh-Palabuhanratu Geopark & Badan Geologi ESDM
properties.geometry_note: Polygon representation of complex boundary (interface visual convention)

properties.name: Kompleks Mélange Karangsambung (Ophiolite Complex)
properties.description: Cretaceous subduction accretionary complex exposing ophiolite sequence, pillow basalts, red chert, and tectonic mélange in Kebumen, Central Java.
properties.rock_type: Pillow Basalt, Red Chert, Serpentinite, Mica Schist
properties.evidence_description: Deep marine pillow basalts and radiolarian chert blocks structurally chaotic in scaly clay matrix.
properties.evidence_significance: Classic Indonesian tectonic benchmark site illustrating ancient subduction zone lithologies.
properties.why_it_matters: Karangsambung serves as Indonesia's open-air geological laboratory for studying subduction zone dynamics and ophiolite emplacement.
properties.source: Balai Informasi Geologi Karangsambung & Badan Geologi ESDM
properties.geometry_note: Polygon representation of complex boundary (interface visual convention)
